laws.rule: Medvednica Nature Park prohibits lighting fires in the park. The park also asks visitors to observe the prohibition on camping outside approved camps. This applies to the park, which spans Zagreb City, Zagreb County and Krapina-Zagorje County.
laws.heading: Čovjek i priroda, visitor rules

laws.rule: Medvednica Nature Park asks visitors to keep dogs on a lead and not pick plants. This is park visitor guidance, not a county-wide rule.
